title.narrative: Access Governance & Reform for the Electricity and Water Sectors Project

description.narrative: The objectives of the Project are to (i) expand access to renewable-based electricity and drinking water services in selected urbanand peri-urban areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo, (ii) improve the commercial performance of the public electricity and water utilities, and (iii) strengthen the capacity of selected provincial and national institutions in the electricity and water sectors.
